definition.name: apply_dashboard_spec
definition.description: Compile the authoritative run plan and final-data visualization contract into trusted Vue page and CSS artifacts. Pass {} to accept the authoritative template; templateId/variantId are optional assertions, never overrides. Prefer this once for standard dashboard generation instead of reading and rewriting whole Vue/CSS files.

templateId.description: Optional assertion matching the authoritative template; omit to derive it safely.

variantId.description: Optional assertion matching the authoritative variant; omit to derive it safely.

dataPrerequisites.description: quote contains an identified symbol and finite price
the latest 20 kline bars contain finite closes and the latest bar contains volume
computed or technical data contains positive MA5 and MA20 values consumed by the renderer
the latest K-line volume and positive 20-day average volume consumed by the renderer are present
computed or technical data contains bounded drawdown and non-negative volatility signals
quote contains an identified symbol and finite price
financials contains at least two identified report periods
fundamentalIndicators contains at least two revenue and profit points
financialQuality contains one bounded, attributable score with strengths, watch items, and limitations
announcements declares an explicit announcements array, including an empty array when no events are available
quote contains an identified symbol and finite price
the latest 20 kline bars contain finite closes and the latest bar contains volume
computed or technical data contains positive MA5, MA10, MA20, and MA60 values used by the chart and trigger rail
latest and average volume are available for confirmation conditions
bounded drawdown and non-negative volatility are available for the risk boundary

capabilities.reason: The base renderer does not implement breakout price bands and invalidation workflow.

dataPrerequisites.description: financials contains at least two identified report periods
fundamentalIndicators contains at least two revenue and profit points
the selected period contains a cash-flow comparison or an explicit limitation

capabilities.reason: The base renderer does not implement period-over-period decomposition.

dataPrerequisites.description: assets and comparison.rows cover the same two or more symbols
every comparison row contains return, drawdown, and volatility metrics
selectionRanking.rows ranks every covered symbol in unique contiguous 1..N order with non-increasing finite scores
every asset declares its real data source

capabilities.reason: The stock-selection renderer does not implement risk contribution or a correlation matrix heatmap.
The stock-selection renderer does not implement the full liquidity/trend exclusion workflow.
The generic comparison renderer does not implement sector proxy semantics or stage-ranking changes.
No trusted capital-flow renderer is implemented.

dataPrerequisites.description: assets and comparison.rows cover the same two or more research candidates
every candidate contains return, drawdown, and volatility metrics
selectionRanking ranks every research candidate with an auditable score
screener parameters and an explicit risk limitation are present
every candidate declares its real data source

capabilities.reason: The base renderer does not implement auditable signal-rule editing and overlays.

dataPrerequisites.description: backtest contains explicit strategy_id and strategy_name source fields, windows, and fees
backtest.summary contains return, drawdown, trade count, and applicable win rate
backtest contains an equity series and a displayable trades array whose completed rows equal summary.trade_count

capabilities.reason: The base renderer does not implement return distribution or maximum-loss forensics.

dataPrerequisites.description: holdings and assets cover the same two or more symbols with weights summing to 100%
every holding contains return, drawdown, and volatility metrics
concentration, correlation, liquidity, and explicit position-data gaps cover the portfolio
every holding asset declares its real data source

capabilities.reason: The holding renderer does not implement constrained rebalance scenarios.
